svg.text: USB-C supplies the target. Programmer signals must be 3.3 V; its VOUT is deliberately disconnected.
U8 gates all four channels until 3.0 V rail qualification plus 200 ms. TMUX powered-off signal limit is 3.6 V.
NRST has its own channel; programmer reset does not disable the other channels. Verify SWD timing on the prototype.
